_doc: Per-ticker translation of industry/company drivers into scenarios. Every number here is an editable assumption unless its _src says otherwise.

industry._note: NTM EPS growth = beta x hyperscaler capex growth (constant share and margins)

industry._src: gm and opex from Sandisk FQ1 FY27 release (85.1% non-GAAP GM; opex 513M on 11.0B revenue = 4.6%); cost/bit and opex growth are assumptions

CRWV._src: backlog 133B and 36% converting within 24 months per CoreWeave Q3 2026 call/Zacks summary; capex 37-39B 2026 and 'in line' for 2027 per CFO; 2027 OCF is an assumption (Q3 2026 OCF was 2B)
